title: Cuisinart Gourmet Pro Convention, Steam and Air Fryer Oven $329.40 Delivered (40% off Storewide) @ Cuisinart
body:
Deal: Cuisinart Gourmet Pro Convention, Steam and Air Fryer Oven $329.40 Delivered (40% off Storewide) @ Cuisinart

[MS Paint] which is all the mom is asking for now
Why only USA mums?
[Packab] Very good price. I got one of these four months ago for $440 and that was a good deal. I can vouch these are a great little oven. I use it most days. The self clean function is terrific. I can recommend.
[Jklaro] You think its good for steak, burgers, lamb chops?
[Packab] never tried. I use a fry pan for steak and burgers.
[EssendonUser] Agree, I paid the similar price - very happy with it.
[MaxHashrate] Got this one. Using it almost everyday and it is great
[The Hobo] Costco have a similar version without steam for $249.99
[wewehalim] was eyeing for breviller smart oven air fry. This one looks good as well, hmm
[EssendonUser] this one is better if you are looking for fully stainless steel..Breville has some kind of coating inside though it says stainless steel.
[blueboy410] I have the non-steam version, and in my opinion, it is not that good. The heat is not evenly distributed, and not consistent as well. Need to check my food every 2-3 mins, and sometimes the rear area got burnt fast.
[sleepyowl] I had this for a bit of time and the ninja combi and stuck with the combi in the end.
I really wanted to like the Cuisinart as it was fully stainless steel and a bigger size but it was significantly inferior in both air frying and steaming, which were the two main things I needed from it.
Basically the air fryer felt more like my full sized ovens, which resulted in dryer chips. The steaming while it's closer to a real combi oven, is also oddly drying, frozen dumplings never turned out as good as the ninja's.
[armageddeus] I had the previous version of this Cuisinart steam oven (without the air fryer function). Steam function stopped working within first year. Got a replacement, then same steam function packed again just after warranty (2 years later). Cuisinart refuse to honour warranty even after mentioning ACL rights. Not sure what's post warranty is like with other people, but my experience wasn't great. I'd even bought them as family gifts when I first got mine as the steam heating function was preferred over microwave for health-sake. Mixed feelings whether to give this one another go.
[Laziofogna] This looks very similar to the one Aldi sell periodically
